text:
Terry: Cozy idea  cocoa & mismatched-socks mini party on Thu lunch? :mug: :socks:
Nina: Love it. I'll bring hot cocoa mix + little marshmallows (SF).
Omar: I can bring peppermint stirrers and a thermos. Also have some novelty socks to donate to the prize pile.
Priya: Can we make it a tiny charity drop too? Socks for shelter?
Luis: Yes please. I have a contact at the shelter near the office. Happy to coordinate pickup.
Terry: Sweet. Plan: 12:15-1:00pm in the kitchen table area. Bring 1 sealed snack or a pair of new socks if you want to swap/donate.
Nina: Quick poll: do we want a stupid-sock runway contest or just chill? React with :trophy: for runway, :heart: for chill.
Omar: :trophy: from me. Highly competitive socks.
Priya: :heart: but will still wear ridiculous socks.
DevBot: Reminder: please label allergens on any snacks. Also office-bake rules: no unsealed homemade items left unattended.
Luis: Will make a tiny sign for the table and a box labeled "donate - new socks".
Terry: Also small winners: Best Mismatch, Most Holiday Pattern, Most Likely To Be Grandpas, judged by applause.
Nina: Ill bring a tiny bluetooth speaker for background tunes. Nothing loud.
Omar: GIF incoming of my socks on the runway  hold me.
Priya: Bringing a stack of paper cocoa cups and napkins.
Terry: Awesome team. If anyone needs to ship something to the office before Thu, DM me. Otherwise see you Thursday  mismatched-sock + cocoa energy. :sparkles:
